citation.title: Prediction of plasma rotation velocity and ion temperature profiles in EAST Tokamak using artificial neural network models
citation.authors: Lin Z., Zhang H., Wang F., Bae C., Fu J., Shen Y., Dai S., Jin Y., Lu D., Fu S., Ji H., Lyu B.

topic: Neural-network replacement of Voigt fitting for EAST x-ray crystal spectrometer (Ar XVII) line-integrated Ti and relative rotation, plus CNN emulation of non-circular Abel inversion.
own_question: Can DNN/CNN map raw XCS spectra (and EFIT scalars) directly to fitted line-integrated or inverted Ti/rotation faster than conventional fitting?
actual_method_and_evidence: Labels come from the conventional nonlinear Voigt least-squares fit (530 shots, 2649 time slices). GA-initialized 2x9 DNN and 10-layer CNN were evaluated by R2 and Laplace error parameters. A test R2 of 0.9625 is reported for the DNN. Average per-profile times are reported as 1.126 s for fitting, 0.044 s for DNN and 0.031 s for CNN; the CNN uncertainty is computed by varying the input range. Inverted-profile CNN results are compared with CXRS on selected shots. Evaluation is offline. The text describes the split as random 70/20/10, and test-set independence is not stated.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: Prior work has trained NNs to emulate conventional spectral fitting of XCS argon spectra on EAST, reporting per-profile inference in tens of ms versus about 1 s for fitting.
claim_checks.qualification: The source maps a current-frame spectrum to that frame's fit, i.e. an upstream spectrum reader. It does not do temporal nowcasting from past reports. The quantity is Ar impurity line-integrated Ti, and evaluation was offline with no real-time deployment.

claim_checks.allowed_intro_or_theory_claim: Such emulators are trained on conventional fit outputs as labels, so they reproduce the fit rather than independent truth.
claim_checks.qualification: Our reading of the method. CXRS comparisons are few shots only.

input_target_timing_if_relevant: Input is the current frame's raw XCS spectrum (101 pixels), plus EFIT scalars for the inverted-profile model. Target is the same-frame fit. Accumulation is roughly 0.09 s needed for the stated R2 thresholds. No report arrival latency was measured.
validation_if_relevant: Random train/validation/test split within the EAST data; for the CNN the validation set was merged into training. A detector-shift shot is shown as a single robustness example. No campaign-held-out set is reported.
forbidden_inferences: Do not say it nowcasts or forecasts temperature in time.
Do not claim real-time control was demonstrated.
Do not equate Ar XVII XCS line-integrated Ti with KSTAR carbon CES or with main-ion Ti.
Do not claim it shows downstream nowcasting is unnecessary or that it helps.
Do not treat >10x speedup as deployed latency.
reason_to_include_or_exclude: Include as the example of NN upstream spectrum reading. It contrasts with our downstream causal nowcast and supports the point that faster readers could refresh anchors.
